mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDP growth is positive, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production by more than 1% over two months signals a supply-side contraction, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production slowdowns impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO drops and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over two months, it signals a strengthening demand, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS increases on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded and borrowing costs rise.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS > 2%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of CPIAUCSL increases and high FEDFUNDS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over three months signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer-driven sectors benefit.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
